analytics-legacy: Metrics are unavailable for this report. Upload the demo again to run the current analysis.
analytics-partial: Some metrics have limited source data
comparison-note: Compare the same metric across players. Missing values are excluded.
diagnostics-note: Original diagnostic messages from the analysis service.
grenade-note: Recorded enemy damage from HE grenades and fire. Missing source values remain unavailable.
impact-note: Contextual contribution per round. The analysis service defines the scoring model.
low-confidence-text: The evidence does not support a confident selection.
metric-definitions: ADR: average damage per round. KAST: rounds with a kill, assist, survival or trade. Opening K/D: the first elimination in a round. TK: team kills. Performance, Impact and Mistakes require contextual calculations from the analysis service.
partial-warning: Some match data could not be confirmed. Ratings are unavailable; review the quality notes below.
rating-note: A name appears here only when a contextual rating is available.
round-hint: Select a round to inspect its score and demo ticks.
scoreboard-help: Select a player to explore their match
scoreboard-source: K/D/A comes from the parsed scoreboard. A dash means the metric is unavailable. Side labels refer to the final recorded round.
